llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam indicators: offering genuine branded products (Chacos) at unrealistically low prices, mimicking the official Chacos.com layout and branding, and promising free shipping on abnormally high purchase amounts. WHOIS data shows registration via a proxy in Pakistan, not connected to the real Chacos or Canadian businesses, and the ownership is hidden. There is no proper business contact or verification, all of which are classic signs of a fake online shopping scam targeting consumers looking for deals on branded merchandise.
